page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores with an x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. No local storage is bundled with this instance, and it does not include any GPU hardware accelerators. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance divergence between single-core and multi-core operations. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression registering in the bottom 10%. However, the instance leverages its 16 dedicated cores to deliver average multi-core performance, as evidenced by middle-tier scores in stress-ng multi-core, Passmark CPU, and Geekbench multi-core tests. Memory bandwidth, both cached and uncached, remains within the average range, supporting stable data transfer rates.

The ecs.sn2.3xlarge is suited for workloads that can exploit parallel processing rather than relying on high single-thread execution speeds. Average performance in Passmark database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput makes it a viable candidate for general-purpose web servers, multi-threaded application hosting, and moderate database workloads. Conversely, tasks requiring intensive single-threaded performance or local high-speed storage are constrained by the weak single-core benchmarks and the absence of local NVMe storage.
